name: Encroaching Wildlife
summary: Watcher Biggs was bound for the eastern coast with a caravan when the lost ones attacked. Biggs alone survived, and now wild creatures skulk near the camp. Biggs asks for your help defending it. This follows Help Watcher Biggs.

sections.title: A Camp Under Watch
sections.body: The caravan of Watcher Biggs was bound for the eastern coast, but it never arrived. Lost Ones attacked, killing the guards and smashing the supplies, and Biggs alone survived. Biggs has sworn to protect what supplies remain, yet wild creatures skulk close to the camp. Biggs wants you to help defend it.

sections.title: The Creatures Nearby
sections.body: Biggs names three kinds of creature pressing near the camp: young sawtooth crocolisks, sorrow spinners and swamp jaguars. Eight crocolisks, ten spinners and ten jaguars are to be slain.

faq.q: Where was Watcher Biggs's caravan traveling?
faq.answer: To the eastern coast, but the caravan never reached its goal.
Lost Ones. They killed the guards and smashed the supplies, and Biggs alone survived.
Young sawtooth crocolisks, sorrow spinners and swamp jaguars skulk near it.

faq.q: Why does Watcher Biggs remain at the camp?
faq.answer: Biggs has sworn to protect the supplies that remain from the caravan.
